# 从半平移到同一波矢的配对条件: # From a half translation to pairing at the same wavevector
本工坊位于“自旋空间群：半平移与三层螺旋磁序”课堂。先跟踪真实的跨胞位移，再写: This workshop accompanies the spin-space-group lesson on half translations and a three-layer spin helix. Track the actual intercell displacement, construct the Bloch matrix, and then decide whether the antiunitary operation returns to the same wavevector space. These are separate tests.
## 固定磁性晶胞、基底与相位: ## Fix the magnetic cell, basis, and phase
取边长均为 1 的正交磁性晶胞，两个同类局域轨道 A、B 分别位于 z=0、1/: Use an orthogonal magnetic cell with all three edge lengths equal to 1. Two identical local orbitals A and B are at z=0 and 1/2. The periodic orbital basis is sum_R exp(+2πik·R)|R,alpha,s>, with only the full-cell coordinate R in the exponential. All components of k are magnetic reciprocal-lattice fractions. A full-cell translation n contributes exp(−2πik·n). This differs from an embedded gauge that also includes intracell positions in the exponential.
沿 +z 的半平移先把 A 送到 B，再把 B 送到下一原胞的 A。保持源轨道为: A half translation along +z sends A to B and B to A in the next cell. Source orbitals label matrix columns and destination orbitals label rows. The second map therefore contributes exp(−2πik_z); two half translations leave one full-cell translation. The coordinate z=1 remains unwrapped, so matching arrows after folding cannot discard the phase.
## 从一个波矢空间到另一个空间: ## From one wavevector space to another
Θ 将 k 变成 −k。自旋 1/2 分支取 J=−iσ_y，且 Θ=JK；无自: Theta sends k to −k. The spin-1/2 branch uses J=−iσ_y and Theta=JK; the spinless branch uses J=1 and Theta=K. The first action of A=T_(c/2)Theta is B_A(k)ψ*, with B_A(k)=S(−k)⊗J, and its output belongs to H_−k.
第二次作用使用返回空间的矩阵 B_A(−k)，并共轭第一次得到的整条复向量。因此: The second action uses the returning-space matrix B_A(−k) and conjugates the entire intermediate complex vector. Thus B_A(−k)B_A(k)*=Theta²exp(−2πik_z)I. The interface separately shows B_A(k)² and B_A(k)B_A(k)* as deliberate incorrect comparisons: at generic k they are not valid return operations.
工坊提供一个基矢和一个规范化复态参照。改变初态不改变算符平方；它改变的是各分量如: The workshop supplies a basis vector and a normalized complex reference state. Changing the initial state changes the component-by-component view of conjugation, not the operator square. The overlap of ψ and Aψ is shown only when A returns to the same wavevector under the declared basis identification. At generic k, a coefficient dot product across two different spaces is not presented as a state overlap.
## 为什么只检查纵向波矢不够: ## Why the longitudinal wavevector alone is insufficient
同一 k 条件要求 −k+G=k 且 G 为整数倒格矢，即 2k_x、2k_y、: The same-k condition requires −k+G=k with integer reciprocal vector G, so 2k_x, 2k_y, and 2k_z must all be integers. In this periodic orbital gauge, integer G has the identity basis identification matrix. Input k is neither automatically folded nor stripped of transverse components.
自旋 1/2 的 Γ 点平方为 −I，Z=(0,0,1/2) 的平方为 +I。横: For spin 1/2, the square is −I at Gamma and +I at Z=(0,0,1/2). The generic transverse point (1/4,0,0) has the same −I square but is sent to another k; the square alone cannot establish a doublet at the same k. The spinless branch instead has +I at Gamma and −I at Z, showing the combined role of fractional translation and antiunitarity.
## 从正交到能级：还需 Hamiltonian 对称: ## From orthogonality to energy: Hamiltonian symmetry is also required
若 A 是同一空间中的反幺正等距操作且 A²=−I，反幺正内积关系给出 ψ 与: For an antiunitary isometry A acting in one space with A²=−I, the antiunitary inner-product relation makes ψ and Aψ orthogonal. A symmetry of the Hamiltonian is additionally needed to make their energies equal. The workshop calculates the first two conditions and the actions; it does not test an arbitrary material Hamiltonian.
第一个固定点反例在 Γ 使用幺正 G=T_(c/2)D(C₂x)。它也满足 G²: The first fixed-point counterexample uses the unitary G=T_(c/2)D(C2x) at Gamma. Although G²=−I, H=X_orb⊗I+2I⊗σ_x commutes with G and has four distinct energies −3, −1, 1, 3. A square of −I cannot replace the antiunitarity condition.
第二个反例在自旋 1/2 的 Z 点使用 A=BK、B=J_orb⊗J_spin: The second counterexample uses A=BK with B=J_orb⊗J_spin at the spin-1/2 Z point, where A²=+I. The Hamiltonian H=X_orb⊗σ_x+2Z_orb⊗σ_z preserves A and still has four distinct energies. Both are explicit finite-matrix counterexamples, not material fits. Failure to guarantee pairing does not rule out degeneracy from another cause.
## 图案对照与旧一维实验: ## Pattern comparisons and the original one-dimensional experiment
三维图案保持全部未折回位置，分别显示仅半平移、仅时间反演及组合操作。A 与幺正: The three-dimensional pattern retains all unwrapped positions and separately shows a half translation, time reversal, and their combination. A and the unitary G can produce the same classical moment-arrow changes while acting differently on quantum states. Arrows in the spinless mathematical branch represent an abstract time-odd order parameter.
旧一维实验与这里使用相同的磁性倒格矢分数单位，因此受支持时复制的是 k=k_z。: The original one-dimensional experiment uses the same magnetic reciprocal-lattice fractions, so a supported copy uses k=k_z. Copying is offered only for zero transverse components and longitudinal values allowed by the original form range and step grid. It neither discards transverse momentum nor silently quantizes exact rational input. The complete copied input still requires a manual calculation.
输入只接受有限十进制、整数或 p/q，绝对值不超过 8、分母不超过 100000: Inputs accept only finite decimals, integers, or p/q, with absolute value at most 8 and denominator at most 1000000; expressions are not executed. Exact matrices determine the criteria, while numerical mirrors serve display only. No material magnetic-space-group search, band solution, or topological invariant is calculated.
Mong、Essin 与 Moore 在第 II 节讨论时间反演与半平移的组合。: Mong, Essin, and Moore discuss the combined time-reversal and half-translation operation in Section II. Their half translation squares to a translation along −a3 and they write the Bloch basis differently, giving −exp(+ik3). This workshop fixes a +z half translation and the periodic orbital basis above, giving −exp(−2πik_z). Align translation direction, momentum units, and basis before comparing formulas.
